description: Save an invoice PDF, the same document as Download PDF on porkbun.com, in this server's outbox. The bytes are checked to be a PDF of the size Porkbun states before anything is written. The answer gives the file's path, size and sha256, with Porkbun's own fields: `filename`, `sizeBytes`, and `downloadUrl`, a link that downloads it without signing in until `downloadExpires` (15 minutes). Invoice IDs come from `list_invoices`; an ID not on this account returns `INVOICE_NOT_FOUND`. This server has no outbox yet (PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR), so the call fails until one is set; `get_invoice` still gives the `downloadUrl`.

save_dir.description: A folder inside the outbox to save into (created if missing). Default: the outbox itself.

name: get_invoice_pdf
